messages:
nina (Growth): quick kickoff — we need new hero + CTA variants for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages. goal: clearer funnel paths (self-serve vs sales), plus a benchmark narrative blurb for each. aim to ship tests by Mon.
emma (Marketing): got it. can do 3 headline directions per page: value, econ, and trust. short options only.
kevin (Product): for Dedicated emphasize SLA, reserved capacity and predictable latency. one-liner idea: "Dedicated GPU pools for predictable throughput and enterprise SLAs."
josh (Design): keep hero short and add a 2-line supporting subhead. CTAs: Primary (start free), Secondary (talk to sales). mobile-first layout notes: don't show both CTAs stacked on small screen.
emma (Marketing): hosted headline suggestions:
- "Ship LLM features fast — hosted inference with streaming"
- "From test to prod in minutes: hosted API + transparent pricing"
- "Start building on a production-grade hosted API"
Pick one and I'll craft the subhead.
samir (GrowthOps): inbound routing rules proposal (we'll tag leads at form submit):
```
if product_interest == "Dedicated" or expected_pay > 20000:
  route_to = "enterprise-sales"
elif product_interest == "Private":
  route_to = "solutions-eng"
else:
  route_to = "growth-led-sales"
```
also capture: region, monthly_request_volume, compliance_needs.
emma (Marketing): private page headline ideas:
- "Private deployment: VPC & on-prem inference with audit controls"
- "Keep data in your network, still get Redwood performance"
- "Air-gapped and enterprise-ready LLM serving"
Subheads should mention KMS/HSM and audit logs.
kevin (Product): benchmark narratives — short blurbs under hero. Hosted: latency/cost numbers for common configs (e.g., 8k context, avg 40ms token). Dedicated: predictable p95 latency + throughput numbers. Private: similar but call out regional deployment + compliance. keep them conservative and verifiable.
josh (Design): CTA copy variants to test:
```
Primary: [Start free — Hosted API] | [Get reserved capacity — Dedicated] | [Request private trial — Private]
Secondary: [Talk to a solutions engineer] | [See benchmarks] | [Join webinar: production inference]
```
emma (Marketing): proposed A/B plan: A = emphasis on econ (cost per token + batching benefits), B = emphasis on reliability/SLA. run 2 weeks, measure signups and demo requests.
samir (GrowthOps): for lead scoring add +3 if they select Dedicated or Private and +2 for mention of compliance. auto-tag tags: hosted, dedicated, private, compliance, enterprise.
preview-bot: preview available: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/landing-copy-variants-1719854320 :rocket:
nina (Growth): love this. emma — can you drop final copy options in this thread by EOD? josh — will you mock the hero treatment for mobile + desktop? samir — prep routing config and SharePoint doc for SDRs.
emma (Marketing): will do. sending 3 final options in ~3 hours. :thumbsup:
josh (Design): on it, will post screenshots in #design later today.
samir (GrowthOps): routing doc draft by tomorrow morning.
nina (Growth): perfect — thanks team. we'll pick winners in the weekly marketing sync on Monday. :calendar:
